q-1c8b.rationale: A two-field oracle shares its object with the editor.

defect.invariant: Expected values stay independent of writes to the submitted content.
defect.mechanism: stage(expected) receives the same object later used in deepEqual; an in-place rewrite before publishing changes the oracle too.
defect.counterexample: Stage overwrites one string field in place and release copies that value into the public snapshot: the assertion still passes.

q-248c.rationale: Both assertions read the visitor snapshot and compare both fields; a no-op republish leaves the older snapshot and fails the second assertion.

q-3df5.rationale: The check cannot distinguish full rendering from vertical clipping.

defect.invariant: The full text fits vertically inside the summary box.
defect.mechanism: textContent and a positive clientHeight can hold even when scrollHeight exceeds clientHeight and overflow is hidden.
defect.counterexample: Use the full text, clientHeight 16 and scrollHeight 32. The last line is clipped but both assertions pass.

q-5a2e.rationale: The awaited verification runs in try, and awaited close in finally. A rejected verification still closes the acquired visitor once; with a successful close the original error propagates.

q-7fe0.rationale: The spread separates the oracle from the editor input. Both fields are primitive strings, so a shallow copy suffices; the full object is compared.

q-b901.rationale: The text, positive height, and scrollHeight versus clientHeight are checked; in the specified fixture these detect a vertically clipped summary.

q-e56a.rationale: The final assertion observes the draft instead of the public snapshot.

defect.invariant: A visitor sees both fields of the newly published version after republishing.
defect.mechanism: The final check reads readPreview(), already changed by save(), not readPublic().
defect.counterexample: publishSaved is a no-op: the public snapshot stays older while preview contains newer and the test passes.

q-f640.rationale: The visitor leaks on a rejected verification.

defect.invariant: An acquired visitor is closed exactly once even if verification rejects.
defect.mechanism: The awaited verification rejects before control reaches close; there is no finally.
defect.counterexample: Let createVisitor succeed and verify reject. The error propagates, but the close call count is zero.
